test_title: PYST 10: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: SWER is related to GKSF in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, WAIV is related to KOWJ. To which of the given options is MQYL related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, SWER is related to GKSF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1107b8bec6ac7e719e9d6e4f9bdb163d21702fa9419e0e00db46a0f10e37b94a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d152e372828a087bde7d326342d465e8267f717e2b1a52b33809a65c21d1818.png] 

For, WAIV is related to KOWJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/417bf78d21bd7fe36bcdfa0393fcbdb646bda19da3423bcdbd788b5c7e1edf85.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71121ae8e36bea3fdccb0bc3a9affea159cdd14124c6228fa7417e70615e5e12.png] 

Similarly, for **'MQYL'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb31dc3a91e0b7d03681737ed5713b6a299b4e3660ab7aac2224bff693fa31e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55ec54d22dae4f58296364396b15634b6447cd8be5533c45224ba886c70d7494.png] 

So, ''MQYL' will be related to **'AEMZ'**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
